text:
anna: quick heads-up 1: were proposing a small IA tweak for the left nav: collapse existing micro-groups into three clear zones: Workspaces | Model registry | Insights. Reason: reduce visual noise for new users and make deep-links predictable for external tooling. Posting quick route samples and accessibility asks.

anna: route examples well guarantee (canonical):
```/app/ws/:workspaceId
/app/ws/:workspaceId/registry/:modelId
/app/ws/:workspaceId/registry/:modelId/settings
/app/ws/:workspaceId/insights/requests?range=14d
```

ravi: engineering POV: strongly prefer pathname routing (no hashes). Hash routes cause funky back/forward and break server-side link previews. react-router path routes look cleaner.

jo: PM: path routes are better for external links (emails, tickets). Need migration plan for existing bookmarks — can we do automated redirects?

anna: plan: a tiny server-side redirect map for `/#/` -> `/app/` patterns for 6 months + in-console banner announcing the new URLs. Also emit 301s for crawlers.

lee: UX: label change request 1: "Models & Assets" -> "Model registry". Short and less ambiguous. Keep "Assets" in tooltips or a sub-menu for clarity.

jo: analytics note: we should instrument old vs new path hits to measure breakage. Also capture top 50 bookmarked URLs and check redirect success.

aria-bot: accessibility reminder: when grouping items visually, ensure each zone is a semantic nav landmark. Keyboard users should be able to jump between zones (skiplinks or dedicated tab stops). Breadcrumbs: last item should have aria-current="page".

ravi: implementation sketch:
```<Routes>
  <Route path="/app/ws/:workspaceId" element={<WorkspaceShell/>}>
    <Route path="registry/:modelId" element={<ModelPage/>}/>
    <Route path="insights/:panel" element={<Insights/>}/>
  </Route>
</Routes>
```

ravi: migration shim idea: client-side on mount detect legacy hash pattern, compute canonical path, then replaceState() to avoid polluting history. Also add server redirect rules to catch direct hits.

lee: breadcrumb visual rules: show compact form "WorkspaceName > ModelName" (omit intermediate nouns) but keep full hierarchical segments in the URL. Truncate middle crumbs with an ellipsis on narrow widths.

anna: accessibility detail: when a nav grouping collapses or shifts active item, post a polite aria-live message like "Navigation updated, Models now active". Also announce region & active item when keyboard focus moves between zones.

jo: rollout plan: feature-flagged by workspace. Canary 5% sessions -> 25% over a week. Metrics to watch: deep-link click success, time-to-first-action, search for pages. Rollback threshold: 15% negative delta on critical metrics.

ravi: keyboard nav behavior: up/down within list, Left/Right to jump zones, Home/End to go to first/last in zone. Enter/Space open. Well add unit + e2e tests for focus behavior.

ops-bot: deploy-preview created: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/left-nav-zones (expires in 72h)

jo: docs: Ill draft a short migration note and sample redirect table for Docs & Support. Assign to Solutions to email top customers once banner copy is ready.

lee: small copy tweak: breadcrumb separator should be chevron (>) not slash. Improves readability.

anna: action items:
- anna: finalize high-fidelity mocks + breadcrumb truncation spec (Wed)
- ravi: build react-router prototype + legacy-hash shim (start tomorrow)
- aria-bot: produce formal accessibility checklist and example live-region messages (next Tue)
- jo: draft migration doc + customer comms (Mon)

ravi: will open the RFC PR and tag design + accessibility.

jo: thanks team. locking on pathname-first approach, condensed visual breadcrumbs, focusable zone separators, and a migration shim. will reconvene in Fri design review.

lee: :thumbsup:

aria-bot: automated reminder: schedule a11y QA session after prototype build.
